visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) or subtle gold accent borders for active states
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-sm (2px to 4px) for sharp, corporate high-end look

layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density but with generous padding (p-8). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. KPIs spanning 1 col, charts/lists spanning 2 or 3 cols.
layouts.document_view: Split Screen: Left side (1/3) for stepper/checklist, Right side (2/3) for instant Document Preview. No small popups.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Large hit areas for buttons.

motion.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out on buttons and cards
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased border opacity (border-[#BF953F]/50)
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with subtle slide up (Framer Motion)

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#BF953F] via-[#FCF6BA] to-[#B38728] text-black font-semibold px-8 py-4 rounded-sm hover:opacity-90 shadow-lg text-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#BF953F] text-[#FCF6BA] px-8 py-4 rounded-sm hover:bg-[#BF953F]/10 text-lg
buttons.action_labels: MANDATORY: Use explicit verbs ('Aceptar documento', 'Rechazar documento', 'Guardar y Volver'). NEVER use 'continuar' or 'aceptar' alone.

components.cards: bg-[#141414] border border-white/10 p-8 rounded-sm shadow-2xl
components.stepper: Vertical or Horizontal clear progression bar with Playfair Display numbers and explicit titles.
components.contact_panel: Dedicated sticky or inline section in client view with explicit 'Enviar WhatsApp' (opens wa.me link with pre-filled text) and 'Enviar Correo'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Gold text on black is excellent.

background_texture.description: Golden ribbons flowing on a dark background for login or ambient dashboard texture (opacity 10-20%)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL STATE MANAGEMENT: When Victoria presses the 'Volver' button, the view must restore the EXACT state. You MUST use React Router's `state` object, URL search params, or a global store to persist scroll position, selected tab, and filter state.
Create the app completely in Spanish.
Dashboard KPIs must display large, bold numbers. Use Playfair Display for the metric values to look imposing.

Document Preview: Use an <object>, <iframe>, or `react-pdf` (already in package.json) to show a large preview inline. DO NOT make the user download or click a small link. The 'Aceptar documento' / 'Rechazar documento' buttons must be immediately visible under the viewer.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for complex asymmetrical layouts and Shadcn for complex logic components (select, dropdown, dialog).
Avoid small text. Base font size should be large (text-base or text-lg). Interfaces must feel ample and luxurious.

Implement the 4-step guided flow explicitly with titles: 'Paso 1 - Recepción y clasificación de documentos', 'Paso 2 - Validación de RUT cliente, RUT codeudor, Rol de avalúo y dirección', 'Paso 3 - Revisión final con checklist completo', 'Paso 4 - Envío a ConCreces con confirmación'.
Contactability: Include a WhatsApp button with a pre-filled message using `https://wa.me/NUMBER?text=ENCODED_MESSAGE` format and a 'Enviar Correo' email link.
DO NOT apply `text-align: center` globally. Keep data tabular and left-aligned.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, and major UI components to facilitate testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
